# Now 2.13.75
- Apple Podcasts now actually works, audio and video episodes alike. Podcasts reports every episode as video, and anything reporting video was being turned away before it reached the overlay. That check was both wrong and unnecessary: browsers, the case it was meant for, are handled separately, and genuine video apps are excluded by name. It has been removed, so an episode now appears with its show art, title and progress like anything else.

# Now 2.13.74
- Apple Podcasts now works. The overlay was not appearing for it at all, because Podcasts labels every episode as video, audio-only ones included, and anything labelled video was being turned away. Episodes are now recognised by content type instead, so a podcast shows its show art, title, episode and progress like anything else, with the usual controls. - Removed a check that ran against Podcasts on every update and could never succeed, since Podcasts offers nothing for it to query.

# Now 2.13.73
- Fixed the overlay controls being cut off. The row of buttons had a fixed width that was wider than the album art it sits on, so the outermost ones, previous and full screen, lost their edges against the artwork's rounded corner. It was worst at the compact size but present at both. The buttons are now sized from the artwork, so the row always fits, and the icons keep their size rather than shrinking with it.
